question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing sweeper, and Claire is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) sweeper
(C) right midfielder
solution:
Each tuple lists positions in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (right back, sweeper, right midfielder)
1. Claire swaps with Alice: (right midfielder, sweeper, right back)
2. Alice swaps with Claire: (right back, sweeper, right midfielder)
3. Bob swaps with Claire: (right back, right midfielder, sweeper)
Claire is playing sweeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
